result.description:
A highly rewarding career opportunity is available for a  General Practitioner  to join a progressive and high-demand medical facility located in  Adelaide, SA , within a designated  DPA area . The centre is experiencing huge patient demand and runs a dynamic Immediate Care Centre alongside a dedicated Skin Clinic, all supported by a fantastic, cohesive nursing team. The successful GP will provide comprehensive, continuing medical care for individuals, families, and communities, conducting consultations for both simple and complex health conditions, and delivering a vital range of health services including prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation. Duties will also encompass consulting with other health professionals (nurses, specialists, and allied health), participating in health promotion, and assisting in the education and training of colleagues. The centre operates on a mixed billing model, offering an increased percentage of earnings to attract top talent, coupled with an attractive sign-on bonus. 

 The practice environment is modern and well-equipped, fostering a highly supportive culture that emphasizes clinical autonomy. The GP will benefit from robust qualified nursing support, including assistance with Health Assessments and Care Plans, dedicated administrative assistance, and strong Chronic Disease Management (CDM) support. The collaborative team ensures comprehensive support is available from day one to develop a thriving practice. Special interest opportunities are strongly encouraged, particularly within the on-site Skin Clinic, allowing practitioners to diversify their skillset and scope of practice. This includes opportunities to engage in ongoing education, conduct research, and take on rewarding supervisor roles to mentor the next generation of doctors. 

 Exceptional flexible working arrangements are a key feature of this opportunity, including short-term agreements and the choice to practice a preferred way via appointments, walk-ins, or telehealth consults, providing flexibility to fit any lifestyle. The centre offers no exclusivity requirements, allowing the GP to continue working at their current practice if desired. Professional development is paramount, with access to accredited CPD GP webinars and dedicated educational resources. The location in Adelaide offers significant lifestyle benefits, with the city renowned for its vibrant arts scene, world-class dining, and easy access to natural attractions like the Adelaide Hills and famous wine regions (Barossa Valley, McLaren Vale). The centre provides designated GP car parking with a reserved space. Qualified candidates must hold AHPRA registration, with VR GP Specialist Registration being highly desirable; however, a Non-VR Fellowship Pathway is also available for suitable applicants.   Apply Now

About the Practice :  

 One of Australia’s fastest-growing primary healthcare providers. Our client's unique model co-locates bulk-billed General Practice with dental, radiology, pathology, and allied health services all under one roof, creating a seamless experience for patients and a collaborative environment for healthcare professionals. 

 Through our network of large-scale, purpose-built centers, providing a comprehensive home for patients. Each practice is a high-volume, purpose-built facility that functions as a complete medical home for the local community. By integrating General Practice with dental suites, radiology departments, pathology labs, and allied health services, the practice creates a seamless environment where patients can address multiple health needs in a single visit. 

 The hallmark of the practice is its commitment to accessibility. Most centers operate with extended hours from early morning until late at night, 365 days a year, providing a critical alternative to hospital emergency departments for non-life-threatening issues. This walk-in model ensures a dynamic, high-energy workplace with a diverse range of clinical cases, from routine chronic disease management to acute injury care. 

   

  About the Role:   

 General Practitioners at practices work within a model designed to return the focus to clinical excellence by removing the complexities of business management. GPs join a high-volume, collaborative environment that provides the infrastructure of a large-scale medical center with the clinical autonomy of a private practice. This proximity allows for a unique diagnostic workflow where a GP can refer a patient for imaging or bloodwork and often receive results or specialist input within the same day. 

  About You:   

 
	  Fellowship of the RACGP (FRACGP)  or  Fellowship of ACRRM (FACRRM)  is required. 
	  Specialist Registration  with the  Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA)  is mandatory.

result.description:
Burswood, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 7/07/2026 to 4/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17492
- Residential, commercial, and public landscape projects
- Remuneration package - $79,500 - $85,000 + super
- Join LD Total - Position based in Burswood

About the role

LD Total is a multi-award winning landscape company specialising in landscape architecture services, irrigation design, commercial landscape construction, maintenance and residential lot packages. 

At LD Total, our design team play an active role in shaping the company and the landscape with the focus on quality and innovative design and delivery of projects. 

In order to support the continued growth of our business in WA, LD Total is seeking appointment of a Landscape Architect to assist in providing fully integrated Landscape Architecture design and delivery of master planned land development communities including public open spaces, public sector projects, playgrounds, industrial estates, urban projects, and ecological projects.

There is the opportunity to further develop your professional and technical knowledge in all aspects of the landscaping industry through regular team building and social / professional networking events and UDIA / AILA affiliations.

As a Design & Construct company we work alongside our construction team to ensure our landscape vision hits the ground. This means more time to design and work with our clients and less time spent undertaking contractual tasks. We work with a range of clients in Perth, from the large diversified property groups through to smaller developers and builders. 

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop landscape architecture concepts for residential, commercial, and public projects
- Prepare design documentation, including plans, specifications, and reports
- Collaborate with clients, engineers, planners, and other stakeholders
 -Conduct site analysis, feasibility assessments, and environmental impact considerations
- Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables
- Ensure compliance with Australian standards, planning regulations, and sustainability principles

Skills and Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Landscape Architecture or a closely related field
- Minimum 12 months relevant work experience
- Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or GIS tools
- Strong knowledge of Australian standards and local planning frameworks
- Design, drafting and technical support for landscape projects on a variety of project sizes and complexities
- Excellent communication and project coordination skills
 -Self-motivated, professional and reliable

A remuneration package between $79,500 to $85,000 per annum + super will be offered to the successful candidate.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and portfolio outlining your relevant experience - https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17492.php
